integrity: Standalone direct RREF verification and complete symbolic derivation; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Central stabilizations of the two-dimensional nonabelian affine Lie algebra only; fixed-rank large-field limit only. Small-field exhaustive calculations corroborate but do not establish the symbolic general theorem. Earlier low-dimensional cases and a four-dimensional numerical coincidence with a different family are prior coverage; an implicit older lattice formula remains a historical-priority risk.
title: Parity phase transition for subalgebra permutability in centrally stabilized affine Lie algebras
